title: Version ranges, the four operators that matter
why: Number-vs-string comparison and prerelease precedence are the two places an implementation that looks right returns the wrong boolean, and both are cheap to test.
requirements: Write `src.js` exporting `satisfies(version, range)` returning a boolean. `version` is `MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH` with an optional `-prerelease`. `range` is an exact version or one prefixed with `^`, `~`, `>=`, `<=`, `>`, or `<`. Caret stays within the same major, tilde within the same minor, and a prerelease version does not satisfy a range whose base has no prerelease. Compare version components as numbers. Throw on input you cannot parse. No dependencies.
